title: Affine tensor dictionary for completed internal-Hom sections
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $F,G$ coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the quotient systems and transitions of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and put $H=\mathcal Hom(G,F)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For each $n$ suppose $e_n:H/I^{n+1}H\to\mathcal Hom(G/I^{n+1}G,F/I^{n+1}F)$ satisfies the equation obtained by precomposing by the quotient projection of $G$ and postcomposing by the quotient projection of $H$: its result is postcomposition by the quotient projection of $F$. For an affine open $U$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], set $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $J=I(U)$, $B=\widehat A$, $N=G(U)$ and $M=F(U)$. There are a bijection $\rho$ from compatible families of sections of $H/I^{n+1}H$ over $U$ to $B\otimes_A\operatorname{Hom}_A(N,M)$ and a $B$-linear map $\beta$ from this tensor product to $\operatorname{Hom}_B(B\otimes_A N,B\otimes_A M)$, such that $\beta(1\otimes h)$ is scalar extension of $h$. For every compatible family $t_n:G/I^{n+1}G\to F/I^{n+1}F$ there is an element $v$ of that last Hom module such that for every compatible section family $s$, the equations $e_n(U)(s_n)=t_n|_U$ for all $n$ are equivalent to $\beta(\rho(s))=v$. No bijectivity of $\beta$ is asserted.

proof.text: Coherence gives quasi-coherence and finite type for N and M. Reuse Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_over from FinitePushforwardCoherent (a proof-only import all) for finite type over U. The affine finite-type criterion gives finite generation of sections. The affine ring is Noetherian, hence Hom_A(N,M) is finite by the Mathlib instance.

Use Mathlib completion-tensor equivalences cH,cN,cM. Construct beta by AlgebraTensorModule.lift from b,h mapped to b times baseChangeHom(h). Its generator equation follows from one_smul. Let C = arrowCongr cN cM and epsilon = C composed with beta composed with cH inverse. Mathlib tensor_map_id_left_eq_map and the inverse tensor-completion formula on of(h) show epsilon(of(h)) = map J h.

Apply the completion-only affine evaluation theorem to epsilon. It returns q and maps w representing t. Set rho = cH inverse composed with q and v = C inverse(w). The given iff becomes C(beta(rho(s))) = w, equivalent by the inverse equivalence identity to beta(rho(s)) = v. This is the required statement, with its generator equation already proved.

proof_origin.place: Affine-local proof, with tensor transport formalized using Mathlib AsTensorProduct and arrowCongr. The sheaf/limit identification is isolated as completion-only evaluation.

theorem completion_internal_hom_affine_tensor_dictionary {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : CoherentModules X)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ,
      formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) (SheafOfModules.homObj
        (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) G.obj F.obj) ⟶
        SheafOfModules.homObj
          (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) G.obj)
          (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) F.obj))
    (he : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ,
        formalModuleQuotientπ I (n.unop + 1) (SheafOfModules.homObj
          (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) G.obj F.obj) ≫
          e n ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap
            (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) (formalModuleQuotientπ I (n.unop + 1) G.obj)
            (𝟙 (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) F.obj)) =
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap
          (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) (𝟙 G.obj) (formalModuleQuotientπ I (n.unop + 1) F.obj))
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let A := Γ(X, U.val)
    let B := AdicCompletion (I.ideal U) A
    let N := Γ(G.obj, U.val)
    let M := Γ(F.obj, U.val)
    ∃ ρ : {s : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ,
          (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) (SheafOfModules.homObj
            (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) G.obj F.obj)).val.obj (op U.val) //
          ∀ (a b : ℕᵒᵖ) (f : a ⟶ b),
            ((formalCompletionSystem I (SheafOfModules.homObj
              (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) G.obj F.obj)).map f).val.app (op U.val)
              (s a) = s b} ≃ (B ⊗[A] (N →ₗ[A] M)),
    ∃ β : B ⊗[A] (N →ₗ[A] M) →ₗ[B] (B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] M),
      (∀ h : N →ₗ[A] M, β (1 ⊗ₜ[A] h) = LinearMap.baseChangeHom A B N M h) ∧
      ∀ (t : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) G.obj ⟶
        formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) F.obj),
        (∀ (a b : ℕᵒᵖ) (f : a ⟶ b),
          t a ≫ (formalCompletionSystem I F.obj).map f =
            (formalCompletionSystem I G.obj).map f ≫ t b) →
        ∃ v : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] M, ∀ s,
          (∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (e n).val.app (op U.val) (s.val n) =
            ((SheafOfModules.homObjSectionsEquiv (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
              (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) G.obj)
              (formalModuleQuotient I (n.unop + 1) F.obj)).symm (t n)).val (op U.val)) ↔
            β (ρ s) = v
